title: Cerebras set for debut in stock market gripped by AI mania
title_zh: Cerebras 即将在人工智能热潮中首次亮相股市
summary: Chipmaker Cerebras is set to make its U.S. market debut later on Thursday, as it looks to ride a wave of investor euphoria for companies that ‌are at the heart of the artificial intelligence boom.
summary_zh: 芯片制造商 Cerebras 将于周四晚些时候在美国市场首次亮相，该公司希望借助投资者对处于人工智能热潮核心的公司的兴奋浪潮。

title: Photonics is 'phase 3' of AI infrastructure build. But what is photonics?
title_zh: 光子学是人工智能基础设施建设的“第三阶段”。但什么是光子学？
summary: The Nasdaq Composite (^IXIC) leads Wednesday's stock gains alongside the S&P 500 (^GSPC), the former ending the trading day 1.2% higher as the sector rallied.
summary_zh: 纳斯达克综合指数 (^IXIC) 与标准普尔 500 指数 (^GSPC) 一起领涨周三的股市涨幅，随着该板块的上涨，纳斯达克综合指数收盘上涨 1.2%。

title: UK opens antitrust probe into Microsoft's business software
title_zh: 英国对微软商业软件展开反垄断调查
summary: Britain launched an antitrust investigation into Microsoft's dominance in business software that could ‌lead to targeted action if the U.S. company ‌is found to have "strategic market status" in the sector.
summary_zh: 英国对微软在商业软件领域的主导地位发起反垄断调查，如果发现这家美国公司在该领域拥有“战略市场地位”，可能会导致采取有针对性的行动。

title: S&P 500, Nasdaq futures rise to new highs as Nvidia jumps
title_zh: 随着英伟达股价上涨，标准普尔 500 指数和纳斯达克期货升至新高
summary: May 14 (Reuters) - Futures tracking the S&P 500 and the Nasdaq rose to record highs on Thursday as Nvidia's shares jumped, while investors watched developments around the high-stakes U.S.-China summit
summary_zh: 路透 5 月 14 日 - 随着英伟达股价上涨，追踪标准普尔 500 指数和纳斯达克指数的期货周四升至历史新高，同时投资者关注高风险中美峰会的进展

title: The S&P 500's earnings boom is facing a bond market warning: Chart of the Day
title_zh: 标准普尔 500 指数的盈利繁荣正面临债券市场警告：每日图表
summary: Stocks are hitting records as earnings surge. Meanwhile, bonds are competing harder for investor cash.
summary_zh: 随着盈利飙升，股市创下历史新高。与此同时，债券正在更加激烈地争夺投资者的现金。

title: Space Stock Craze Comes to Europe as One UK Fund Quadruples
title_zh: 英国一只基金翻两番，太空股热潮席卷欧洲
summary: (Bloomberg) -- It’s not just US retail investors piling into any asset connected to space exploration.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——不仅仅是美国散户投资者涌入任何与太空探索相关的资产。

title: AI Bond Binge Overwhelms Wall Street, Pushes Alphabet Abroad
title_zh: 人工智能债券热潮席卷华尔街，将 Alphabet 推向海外
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Bankers were still putting the final touches on Alphabet Inc.’s blockbuster $17 billion of bond sales when word started to spread Monday morning on Wall Street: the company is already hawking more debt.Most Read from BloombergIran’s Kharg Island Oil Jetties Empt...
summary_zh: （彭博社）——周一早上，银行家们仍在对 Alphabet Inc. 170 亿美元的巨额债券销售做最后的准备时，华尔街开始传出该公司已经在兜售更多债务的消息。

title: Xi Tells US CEOs Accompanying Trump That China Will Open Up More
title_zh: 习近平向陪同特朗普的美国CEO表示中国将进一步开放
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Xi Jinping signaled China is moving toward greater openness, striking an upbeat note during his meeting with US business leaders accompanying Donald Trump as the two presidents wrapped up morning talks that featured more divisive issues like trade and Taiwan.Mos...
summary_zh: （彭博社）——习近平在陪同唐纳德·特朗普会见美国商界领袖时发出了中国正在走向更加开放的信号，在两国总统结束了上午的会谈时，他表达了乐观的态度，会谈的重点是贸易和台湾等更具分歧性的问题。

title: What to Expect From the Trump-Xi Summit in Beijing
title_zh: 对北京特习会有何期待
summary: (Bloomberg) -- President Donald Trump became the first US leader in almost a decade to visit China when he landed in Beijing on Wednesday.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——唐纳德·特朗普总统周三抵达北京，成为近十年来第一位访问中国的美国领导人。
